# Ctrl-C stops the command and leaves the run open with its claim held. The next obee run continues the same run.
! exec obee run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.hcl &
waitfile started
kill -INT
wait

exec obee status
stdout '^item-7-r1\trunning$'
! grep '^release' events.log

exec obee run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.hcl
stdout 'item 7 finished'

exec obee status
stdout '^item-7-r1\tdone\tmerge: merged$'
! stdout 'item-7-r2'

grep -count=1 '^plan ' calls.log
grep -count=2 '^implement ' calls.log

cmp events.log expected-events.log

-- hang --
implement
-- verdicts --
approve
-- expected-events.log --
claim 7
ready 7
release 7
